purpose: Make non-player characters, armies, courts, factions, institutions and states pursue campaigns and interact without requiring Tang Wei to be present.
player_intent_boundary: Out-of-character player wishes, possible future plans, preferred appointments, alliances, acquisitions, marriages, campaigns and hypothetical allocations are not canonical world state. Persist them only after an in-world player action, communication, standing order, commitment, or explicit request to create a noncanonical external note.
selection_rule: Choose actions only from current goals, information, legal/political authority, command, treasury, manpower, grain, horses, equipment, routes, weather, logistics, relationships, audience-known reputation, opposition and risk tolerance. Canon supplies pressures, not forced victories.
materialization_rule: Before a material operation resolves, commit actor, target, objective, command chain, exact personnel removed from source pools, equipment/mounts/supplies/money, origin, route, start time, orders, withdrawal conditions, known information, opposition, next clock and success/failure/abort conditions.
npc_mission_rule: Courts, commanders, houses, institutions and employers may assign or contract NPC people/forces without player involvement when authority and terms exist. Discretionary actors may accept, reject, negotiate or defect according to current motives, contracts and constraints.
interaction_rule: Intersecting marches, raids, patrols, sieges, convoys, diplomacy and intelligence actions wake all affected owners immediately. NPC-vs-NPC conflict and cooperation resolve even when Tang Wei never observes them.
combat_rule: Use the same formation, personal combat, injury, morale, siege, logistics and command mechanics as player-visible battles. Named officers remain exact; mass soldiers resolve through conserved homogeneous units. Persist casualties, prisoners, desertion, equipment loss, ammunition, horse loss, fatigue, morale, position and time.
territory_rule: Conquest requires actual military/political control: access, defeated/withdrawn/negotiated opposition, occupation/garrison capacity, supply and communication, authority or imposed administration, and a persisted territory/control transaction. A battlefield win alone is not annexation.
successor_rule: After an operation, surviving autonomous owners replan and may continue campaigns, counterattack, reinforce, negotiate, occupy, withdraw or demobilize. During time skips successor actions continue through the remaining interval unless blocked or a hard player decision is reached.
information_rule: Distant events change world truth when they occur. Tang Wei learns them only after valid courier, scout, spy, merchant, diplomatic, prisoner, public or physical-evidence paths deliver the information.
efficiency_rule: State and independent macro processes handle stable distant activity. Owners with active plans, orders, contracts, operations, or unresolved commitments receive the daily autonomous-heartbeat review or an earlier exact causal wake; slow monthly or quarterly life, development, or resource coverage alone does not satisfy action liveness. Materialize exact armies, operations, messages, events and battle sectors only when consequences require them; never simulate every soldier individually.
storage_rule: Persist instantiated autonomous operations in existing domain authorities rather than a new parallel operation store: campaigns/strategic operations in state/arc/*; consequential events/messages in state/event/*; contracts/projects in state/contract/*; current armies/formations/movement/losses/control in state/force/* and state/form/*; geography/control in state/geo/*; and scheduling/process ownership in state/time/frontier.json plus process registries. Use cold game/data/content archetypes only to create an operation, never as active state.
operation_lifecycle: review current goals, knowledge, authority, location, resources, relationships, opposition and standing orders
select a lawful action or explicit no-material-action result
for a material action, instantiate the operation in the proper current-state authority before outcome resolution
commit participants, command, route/location, resources, timing, knowledge, opposition and abort/success/failure conditions
advance movement, communication and preparation through actual elapsed time
detect intersections and causally wake every affected autonomous owner
resolve local conflict/cooperation through the same domain mechanics used for player-visible actions
persist casualties, injuries, prisoners, resources, equipment, position, control, relationships, family/household state when causal, knowledge, reputation evidence and other consequences
propagate information only through valid channels
replan surviving autonomous owners and continue successor actions through remaining elapsed time
large_conflict_efficiency_rule: Never resolve every ordinary soldier individually. Keep named/unique actors exact; keep materially different formations, terrain, equipment, morale, doctrine and special capabilities separate; resolve homogeneous ordinary personnel through conserved unit distributions arranged in formations and deterministic mechanics. Split aggregation whenever a named/unique ability, threshold, local terrain, command break, casualty concentration, pursuit, surrender, siege sector or other material asymmetry can change the result.
reputation_rule: Autonomous actors may react to reputation only through an audience profile/direct knowledge they can actually access. Reputation events propagate through existing information/message/institution processes; they never create free knowledge, authority, or direct combat modifiers.
family_rule: Autonomous family transitions use state/family/ plus game/data/mechanics/family.json and existing life-course/House/institution clocks. They require actual relationship/goal/opportunity/law/health/time support; player choices are never inferred; private family facts remain knowledge-gated.
